# gws workflow: File announce

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the `+file-announce` workflow: announce a Drive file in a Google Chat space, teaching the cross-service pattern « upload to Drive with `gws drive +upload`, then announce it here » — with required flags documented (`--file-id`, `--space`, optional `--message`) and the file name fetched from Drive to build the announcement. A workflow, not a reference: distinct from the lot 31 workflows (none announce files in Chat); complements `googleworkspace-cli-gws-chat` and `googleworkspace-cli-gws-chat-send` in this lot. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: a write command (sends a Chat message) — always confirm with the user before executing; requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (Chat API generally needs a paid Google Workspace account); the `gws-drive` prerequisite comes from the same repo but is not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
